# Annetta Bell

## Overview

- **Gender:** female  <sub>[v2 XII A Jonah Day P25](../source/v02-c12.md#nw-v02-c12-p0025)</sub>
- **Status:** alive  _(assumed)_

## Appearance

Annetta Bell is described as a pale, small girl. She has fine, silky, fawn-colored hair that flows over her shoulders in smooth ripples.

_Sources: [v2 V A Full-fledged Schoolma’am P6](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0006)_

## History

Annetta Bell previously lived in the [Newbridge](../codex/places.md#newbridge) school district before her parents moved their house fifty yards north, placing them in [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea). She later became a student at the [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) school under the instruction of [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md). During a school assignment, Annetta admitted to [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) that she had copied love letters for her composition.

_Sources: [v2 V A Full-fledged Schoolma’am P6](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0006), [v2 XI Facts and Fancies P0](../source/v02-c11.md#nw-v02-c11-p0000), [v2 XI Facts and Fancies P9](../source/v02-c11.md#nw-v02-c11-p0009), [v2 XI Facts and Fancies P26](../source/v02-c11.md#nw-v02-c11-p0026), [v2 XI Facts and Fancies P38](../source/v02-c11.md#nw-v02-c11-p0038)_
